description: Add CloudFront API proxy behavior so the frontend can call relative /api paths instead of requiring VITE_API_URL to be baked at build time. Eliminates the post-deploy manual step of rebuilding the frontend with the real API Gateway URL.
steps: Add a second CloudFront origin pointing to the API Gateway endpoint (HttpOrigin with origin path set to the stage /prod)
Add an additional CloudFront behavior for path pattern /api/* that forwards requests to the API Gateway origin, including Authorization header forwarding
Update frontend API client to use /api as the BASE_URL instead of VITE_API_URL environment variable
Remove CORS preflight configuration from API Gateway since requests are now same-origin
Update tests if needed to reflect CloudFront distribution changes
acceptance_criteria: CDK synth produces a CloudFront distribution with an additional behavior for /api/*
Frontend API client uses /api as base path without relying on environment variables
Build succeeds for both CDK and frontend
findings: CloudFront does not allow Authorization header in custom OriginRequestPolicy allowList. Used the managed policy ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER instead, which forwards all viewer headers including Authorization to the origin. CloudFront Function rewrites /api/* to /{stage}/* before forwarding to API Gateway. All 15 existing tests pass. CDK synth and frontend build both succeed.
